name: Andrzej Halicki - § 5 - Am 7
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: 5. Takes note of the proposed reintroduction of suspended commitments for the years 2024 and 2025 under the Hungarian cohesion policy programmes, following the lifting of the relevant Council decision under the Conditionality Regulation; regrets the politically motivated application of the budgetary conditionality mechanism against Hungary under the previous sovereignist government , which raises serious concerns about the political and ideological considerations influencing decisions on Union funding; strongly condemns any attempt by the Commission to use Union funding as an instrument of political pressure against Member States whose governments pursue policies that differ from the Commission’s political priorities; stresses that cohesion policy funds must not be used as a means of political coercion or ideological interference in the sovereign decisions of Member States; calls for the immediate and full reinstatement of the suspended commitments to Hungary, including suspended commitments for the years 2022 and 2023;
